_doc: CODE-AGENTS-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): the adapter registry of code agents that edit this codebase, how each is reached, what it costs and which model family it belongs to. Routing by cost and the disjoint-family ensemble rule (from the QNFO fleet's review gate, platform/cloudflare-reference/scripts/review_gate.py) are code in foundation/agents.py. Every adapter has a test that invokes it (tests/foundation/test_agents.py) and a live probe (`python3 -m foundation agents --probe`). Prices are USD per million tokens as recorded in the QNFO review gate on 2026-11-04 or the provider's list price; unknown ones are null and rank last. The executor ladder (foundation/agent_ladder.py) reads the `ladder` field of each adapter: one declaration of the code agents, not two.

adapters.note: the executor's existing second route; no model vendor key needed
from the QNFO review gate: needs reasoning_effort low or it spends its tokens thinking
the QNFO model router reached over HTTP with a bound URL and key; used by the executor ladder
provider API through a bound secret; highest capability, used when the cheaper routes fail or the task is large
a cloud-hosted Claude session runs `foundation executor --pick` and `--record`; needs no key on the host

routing.author_order: cheapest known price first, unknown price after, session route last

ensemble.when: the change touches auth, routes, cache, migrations or workflows
